figures.finding: An employed resident of Belize pays income tax (PAYE) of 25% on taxable income, with a basic allowance of BZ$25,600; a person earning BZ$26,000 a year or less is exempt.
figures.applies: Employment income. The same page's summary line reads "25% on incomes above BZ$29,000 per year"; the detailed figures are held. Bts.gov.bz could not be read (see blockers).

sources.said: Income tax is levied at a rate of 25% on the taxable income of employed residents in Belize whose annual earnings exceed BZ$26,000 (US$13,000). Individuals earning less than this amount are exempt from income tax. The basic allowance is BZ$25,600 (US$12,800).
Income Tax 25% on incomes above BZ$29,000 per year.

figures.finding: Income tax on employment is collected as PAYE, applying only to employee income.

sources.said: This tax, known as PAYE, applies exclusively to employee income and is not considered a cost to be borne by the employer or business.

figures.finding: Social security is 10% of weekly insurable earnings by wage band, split so the employee pays 1.88% at the lowest band rising to 4.5% (employer 8.13% falling to 5.5%) from BZ$500 a week, on insurable earnings capped at BZ$520 a week.
A self-employed person with annual earnings above BZ$75,000 pays business tax on receipts: 6% for professional services, 5% to 15% on commissions and royalties.

sources.said: Businesses, companies, and self-employed persons with annual earnings exceeding BZ$75,000 are required to pay business tax.

figures.finding: General Sales Tax is 12.5%; businesses with annual taxable turnover above BZ$75,000 must register.

sources.said: Belize's General Sales Tax (GST) is a 12.5% consumer tax on goods and services.
Businesses with annual turnover exceeding $75,000 (US$37,500) from taxable activities must register for GST with the Department of GST.

figures.finding: The Act as revised to 2020 taxes an employed resident at 25% of chargeable income after a basic deduction that falls with income ($25,600 up to $26,000, $24,600 to $27,000, $22,600 to $29,000, $19,600 above); from 1 January 2025 the Government raised the exemption so that those earning under $29,000 pay nothing.
figures.applies: Employed residents; Act No. 40 of 2024's own text (the change from 2025) was not read: nationalassembly.gov.bz is suspended.

figures.finding: The basis year is the calendar year, and a return is due by the last day of the third month after it (31 March); an employee whose only income is pay need not file unless claiming a refund or asked.
figures.applies: Every person chargeable, s.2 and s.31 of Cap. 55.

figures.finding: A non-resident is charged as if resident, through the agent or payer in Belize; a payer withholds 25% of management fees, technical services or similar services paid to a non-resident, and 3% of any gross contract payment for services of $3,000 or more, which is a credit against the tax due.
figures.applies: Whether a performer's fee is a 'similar service' under s.113(3) is not stated (see blocker).
